title: MV Quy Nhơn 95: Return to Vietnam (Coming Summer 2025) [CW: Politics]

posts.author: DMHenry
posts.body:
[Content warnings: Politics, warfare]
It is 1995, twenty years after the fall of Saigon marked an end to what Americans knew as the Vietnam War. Although the once war-torn nation now appears poised to emerge as a major economic power, a multitude of dissident guerrilla movements have coalesced into one large independentist movement - the "Sóng" - which proclaims itself as the true heir of Vietnam's national essence and as a fifth column resisting the encroachment of foreign influence.
In an unlikely alliance, Vietnam calls upon its former geopolitical adversary, the United States for help in the warfare against the Sóng - but not everything is as it seems, and like a ghost, the past presides over the present in unforeseen ways...
.
"Quy Nhơn 95"
is a short single-player story-driven RPG set in an alternate history scenario, made with Degica's RPG Maker MV engine. It features a traditional JRPG turn-based combat system and a branching storyline with multiple different endings.
It is set to release in Summer of 2025 on Steam and Itch.io.
Itch.io link:
https://inquisitiveturtlestudios.itch.io/quynhon95
Steam link: Coming very soon!
.
Disclosure of AI usage:
Some character profile icons and on-combat enemy sprites have been generated with Stable Diffusion, and later modified to fit the game's art style. All the tileset and overworld graphics elements are either from the original RTP or self-created.
